problem_text:
A manufacturing firm must allocate its production of a specialized component across ten distinct assembly lines to fulfill specific order quantities, while minimizing the total logistics and handling expense.

The production capacity at each manufacturing facility (set M) is precisely determined:  
*M1 can produce 68 units.  
*M2 can produce 170 units.  
*M3 can produce 99 units.  
*M4 can produce 178 units.  
*M5 can produce 80 units.  
*M6 can produce 147 units.  
*M7 can produce 185 units.  
*M8 can produce 126 units.  
*M9 can produce 155 units.  
*M10 can produce 63 units.

The required order volume for each assembly line (set L) is contractually fixed:  
*L1 requires 31 units.  
*L2 requires 203 units.  
*L3 requires 71 units.  
*L4 requires 202 units.  
*L5 requires 183 units.  
*L6 requires 202 units.  
*L7 requires 29 units.  
*L8 requires 176 units.  
*L9 requires 36 units.  
*L10 requires 16 units.

The per-unit transfer cost, which encompasses handling, internal transport, and quality verification, from each manufacturing facility to each assembly line is provided in the matrix:

| From / To | L1 | L2 | L3 | L4 | L5 | L6 | L7 | L8 | L9 | L10 |
|--|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|-|
| M1 | 11 | 6 | 11 | 2 | 1 | 15 | 9 | 7 | 6 | 19 |
| M2 | 6 | 16 | 3 | 5 | 20 | 14 | 14 | 13 | 14 | 16 |
| M3 | 13 | 1 | 2 | 18 | 7 | 12 | 1 | 11 | 17 | 7 |
| M4 | 1 | 1 | 8 | 8 | 12 | 10 | 5 | 4 | 13 | 17 |
| M5 | 19 | 10 | 6 | 3 | 2 | 10 | 10 | 15 | 17 | 20 |
| M6 | 17 | 11 | 14 | 5 | 11 | 16 | 12 | 7 | 6 | 13 |
| M7 | 1 | 8 | 8 | 5 | 7 | 1 | 19 | 17 | 6 | 4 |
| M8 | 12 | 2 | 13 | 9 | 18 | 20 | 2 | 20 | 2 | 4 |
| M9 | 1 | 2 | 4 | 14 | 15 | 13 | 4 | 18 | 9 | 16 |
| M10 | 5 | 7 | 1 | 10 | 14 | 4 | 17 | 9 | 20 | 20 |

The firm must determine the optimal quantity to transfer from each facility to each line in order to minimize the aggregate expenditure.
